articles.title: 13 Rounds Fired Inside Chandigarh Medical Store: Cashier Shot Dead by Masked Gunmen
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A cashier at a medical store in Chandigarh's Sector 11 was shot dead on Saturday afternoon after two masked men allegedly opened fire inside the shop before fleeing with the help of a motorcycle-borne accomplice, police said.

body.html:
A cashier at a medical store in Chandigarh's Sector 11 was shot dead on Saturday afternoon after two masked men allegedly opened fire inside the shop before fleeing with the help of a motorcycle-borne accomplice, police said.

The victim, identified as Janki Das, sustained critical injuries in the attack and was rushed to a hospital, where he later succumbed to his injuries.

According to police, the incident took place at around 2:30 pm when two masked assailants entered the medical store and fired multiple rounds at Das. A third accomplice allegedly waited outside on a motorcycle, and all three escaped immediately after the shooting.

Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP) Sumer Pratap Singh said the investigation is at a preliminary stage and all possible angles are being examined.

"This incident took place today at 2:30 pm. Two masked individuals arrived at the shop and launched a barrage of gunfire at the shop's employee, Janki Das, before fleeing the scene. An accomplice was waiting outside on a motorcycle, and all three escaped together," the SSP said.

Police said a total of 13 rounds were fired during the attack. Janki Das, a resident of Dhanas, worked as a cashier at the medical store.

Officials have begun collecting CCTV footage from the area and have set up roadblocks across the city to trace the accused.

"The person on the motorcycle did not come inside the shop. We are obtaining CCTV footage and gathering information about him. Roadblocks have been put in place across the city, and every effort is being made to apprehend the accused," SSP Singh added.

Police said the shop owner had not received any prior threats, and the motive behind the shooting is yet to be established.

Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Two Women Allegedly Use Pepper Spray to Rob Patna Jewellery Shop, Locals Foil Escape
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A robbery attempt was reported at a jewellery shop near Kurji Bridge in Patna's Digha area, where two women allegedly posed as customers and used pepper spray in an attempt to steal jewellery. According to reports, the incident took place at around 5:35 pm on Friday, June 12.

body.html:
A robbery attempt was reported at a jewellery shop near Kurji Bridge in Patna's Digha area, where two women allegedly posed as customers and used pepper spray in an attempt to steal jewellery.

According to reports, the incident took place at around 5:35 pm on Friday, June 12. The suspects allegedly sprayed pepper spray on the shop owner in an attempt to incapacitate him and carry out the robbery.

However, the shopkeeper acted swiftly, managed to escape the attack and stepped out of the shop before trapping the two women inside the premises.

Hearing his cries for help, neighbouring shopkeepers rushed to the spot and assisted in apprehending the suspects before they could flee.

The entire incident was captured on the shop's CCTV cameras, and the video is now circulating widely on social media.

Police have taken cognisance of the incident and launched an investigation to ascertain the sequence of events and determine the identities and motives of the accused.

Further investigation is underway.

#Patna #Bihar #JewelleryShop #RobberyAttempt #CCTV

articles.title: ‘Work From Bike?’ Rider Using Laptop While Riding in Hyderabad Sparks Safety Debate and Social
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video purportedly showing a man using a laptop while riding a motorcycle in Hyderabad's Hitec City has gone viral on social media, raising serious concerns over road safety and workplace culture. The incident reportedly took place on Friday, June 12.

body.html:
A video purportedly showing a man using a laptop while riding a motorcycle in Hyderabad's Hitec City has gone viral on social media, raising serious concerns over road safety and workplace culture.

The incident reportedly took place on Friday, June 12. The viral video shows the rider operating a laptop placed on the motorcycle's fuel tank while travelling on a busy road.

The clip quickly drew widespread attention online, with many users expressing alarm over the dangerous act and the potential risk it posed to both the rider and other commuters.

Social media users reacted with a mix of humour and criticism. While one user sarcastically called the rider the "Best Employee of the Year," another labelled him the "Worst Rider of the Year."

Reacting to the viral video, Hyderabad Commissioner of Police VC Sajjanar urged people to prioritise road safety.

In a post on X, Sajjanar said, "Every task has its own method. But seeing people risking their lives to work from a bike like this... the saying that 'when greed gets too much, it turns against your own life' feels literally true."

He further warned that failing to concentrate on the road endangers not only the rider but also other road users.

"Remember... the work you do to fill your stomach shouldn't end up starving you," he said, while appealing to the public to avoid such irresponsible behaviour and travel safely.

However, the Commissioner's remarks also sparked debate online. Several users criticised the wording of his comments and questioned whether the rider was under work-related pressure.

One user remarked that instead of criticising the individual, authorities should identify the company allegedly imposing such demands and take action against it. Another urged the Commissioner to be more careful with his choice of words, while acknowledging the importance of road safety campaigns such as "Arrive Alive."

The incident has reignited discussions on road safety, workplace pressure and responsible behaviour on public roads.

#HitecCity #ViralVideo #RoadSafety #WorkCulture #Motorcycle

articles.title: Collector’s Office Employee Critical After Broad-Daylight Knife Attack in Palghar; Bombay High Court
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 27-year-old woman employed at the Palghar District Collector's Office was critically injured after being allegedly attacked with a sharp weapon in broad daylight in Maharashtra's Palghar city, police said.

body.html:
A 27-year-old woman employed at the Palghar District Collector's Office was critically injured after being allegedly attacked with a sharp weapon in broad daylight in Maharashtra's Palghar city, police said.

The incident took place near the Gold Cinema area at around 6:30 pm, triggering panic among local residents. According to preliminary information, the attacker repeatedly struck the woman on her neck and waist before fleeing the scene.

The victim, identified as Snehal Sawant, was living in a rented accommodation near the Gold Cinema area. She sustained serious injuries and was initially rushed to Palghar Rural Hospital for emergency treatment before being shifted to a private hospital in Boisar for advanced medical care.

Police suspect the attack may have stemmed from a dispute related to a personal relationship. Preliminary investigations indicate that the accused, identified as Amol Mule, allegedly attacked Sawant following tensions between them. Officials said Mule is believed to be employed at the Bombay High Court.

Palghar Superintendent of Police Yatish Deshmukh confirmed the incident and said the exact motive is still under investigation. He visited the crime scene and also met the injured woman to gather information about the attack.

Soon after the incident, officers from Palghar Police Station, led by Police Inspector Anant Parad, reached the spot and launched an investigation. A forensic team was also deployed to collect evidence and reconstruct the sequence of events.

Police have formed multiple teams to trace the accused, who remains absconding. Authorities said efforts are underway to locate and arrest him at the earliest.

While investigators are examining all possible angles, officials said a dispute arising out of a romantic relationship remains one of the primary lines of inquiry.

The incident has sparked concern among residents over the violent attack in a busy part of the city. Police have assured that a thorough investigation is underway and that strict legal action will be taken once the accused is apprehended.

#Palghar #Maharashtra #CrimeNews #KnifeAttack #BreakingNews

articles.title: Midnight Heist Caught on CCTV: Masked Gang Steals 100+ Mobile Phones Worth ₹1 Crore from Khammam
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major theft was reported at a Sonovision mobile showroom near the Zila Parishad office in Telangana's Khammam, where burglars allegedly stole more than 100 mobile phones worth around ₹1 crore.

body.html:
A major theft was reported at a Sonovision mobile showroom near the Zila Parishad office in Telangana's Khammam, where burglars allegedly stole more than 100 mobile phones worth around ₹1 crore.

According to police and eyewitnesses, the theft took place during the early hours of Thursday night after the accused broke open the showroom's locks and entered the premises.

CCTV footage captured one of the suspects opening the locks at around 3:55 am before returning to a car parked outside the showroom. About two minutes later, three individuals stepped out of the vehicle, lifted the shutters and carried out the burglary.

Surveillance cameras inside the showroom showed the masked, gloved and capped burglars using flashlights to search for and collect mobile phones while concealing their identities.

The showroom owner lodged a complaint with the Khammam Police, following which a case was registered.

A clues team visited the spot to collect forensic evidence, while investigators began examining CCTV footage and other leads to identify and trace the suspects.

Police have launched a detailed investigation into the high-value theft.

Further details are awaited.

articles.title: Government Doctor Found Dead, Eye Surgeon Husband Booked as Family Alleges ₹2.5 Crore Secret
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A city-based eye surgeon has been booked after his wife, a government doctor, was found dead under suspicious circumstances at her rented residence in Jalandhar on Wednesday. The deceased, Dr Meenakshi, was found hanging inside a room of the house.

body.html:
A city-based eye surgeon has been booked after his wife, a government doctor, was found dead under suspicious circumstances at her rented residence in Jalandhar on Wednesday.

The deceased, Dr Meenakshi, was found hanging inside a room of the house. Police have registered a case against her husband, Dr Piyush, an eye surgeon associated with a prominent eye hospital, under Section 108 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for abetment to ****.

Authorities said the investigation is underway and the exact cause of death will be determined after the postmortem examination.

The case took a serious turn after the victim's family alleged that Meenakshi had been subjected to domestic abuse and mental harassment for several years. They also claimed that she had recently discovered loans worth nearly ₹2.5 crore had been taken in her name without her knowledge or consent.

According to the family, Dr Meenakshi, who was serving at a government hospital in Kapurthala, had been living separately from her husband since July 2025 due to marital disputes. They alleged that she was planning to seek a divorce and had recently started looking for a separate house.

The matter allegedly came to light when she approached a bank for a home loan and was informed that liabilities of around ₹2.5 crore were already linked to her name. Family members claimed that her signatures did not appear on the relevant loan documents and that a subsequent CIBIL check revealed the outstanding loans, including financing related to vehicles and business activities.

Her father, Pramod Kumar, alleged that the discovery caused immense mental distress to his daughter.

The family has also accused Dr Piyush of maintaining an extra-marital relationship with a nurse employed at the same hospital. According to them, Meenakshi became suspicious and later examined CCTV footage from the hospital, which they claim supported her suspicions. The footage has reportedly been handed over to the police as part of the investigation.

Her parents further alleged that she had been subjected to repeated physical assault and harassment. They claimed there had been previous incidents of violence and alleged that last year Dr Piyush attempted to kill her by strangulation.

Family members said they are awaiting the postmortem findings to determine whether the death was a *** or involved any other circumstances.

They have demanded the immediate arrest of Dr Piyush and a thorough investigation into the alleged harassment, financial transactions and the circumstances surrounding Meenakshi's death.

Attempts by media persons to contact Dr Piyush reportedly did not receive any response till the filing of the report.

articles.title: Man Allegedly Attacked by Brother with Iron Pipe Outside Beed Office
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident of alleged familial violence was reported in Maharashtra's Beed district, where a man was allegedly assaulted by his brother and an accomplice outside the Panchayat Samiti office.

body.html:
A shocking incident of alleged familial violence was reported in Maharashtra's Beed district, where a man was allegedly assaulted by his brother and an accomplice outside the Panchayat Samiti office.

According to police, Samadhan Khindkar had visited the Beed Panchayat Samiti office for personal work when he was allegedly confronted by his brother, Dada Khindkar, and another individual.

The accused reportedly objected to Samadhan's alleged interference in Gram Panchayat matters, leading to a heated confrontation.

The complainant alleged that the duo assaulted him with an iron pipe and fists and also issued death threats during the attack.

Based on Samadhan Khindkar's complaint, Shivajinagar Police registered a case late Wednesday night against Dada Khindkar and another accused.

Police have launched an investigation into the incident and are examining the circumstances surrounding the alleged assault.

articles.title: ‘Won’t Spare Him’: Woman Throws Chilli Powder, Thrashes Alleged Harasser at Raichur Bus Stand
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman allegedly confronted and assaulted a man accused of harassing her at the central bus stand in Raichur city by throwing chilli powder into his eyes, creating a commotion that drew the attention of bystanders.

body.html:
A woman allegedly confronted and assaulted a man accused of harassing her at the central bus stand in Raichur city by throwing chilli powder into his eyes, creating a commotion that drew the attention of bystanders.

The incident took place on Tuesday under the jurisdiction of the Sadar Bazaar Police Station.

According to eyewitnesses, the accused, identified as Raju Bommanal, was loitering around the bus stand while posing as a passenger and allegedly repeatedly harassed and behaved inappropriately towards the woman.

Unable to tolerate the alleged misconduct, the woman reportedly obtained chilli powder from a nearby hotel and threw it into the man's eyes before assaulting him with a stick in full public view.

Witnesses said the woman, visibly enraged, shouted at the accused in front of the gathered crowd, declaring that she was not afraid of legal consequences and would not spare him for his actions.

The incident quickly attracted a large crowd at the busy bus stand. Following the altercation, those present reportedly intervened, counselled the man and sent him away.

No official statement has been issued so far regarding whether a formal complaint has been filed in connection with the incident.

Further details are awaited.

articles.title: Karnataka Constable Allegedly Smashes Car Windshield After Heated Argument with Motorist
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An alleged incident of police high-handedness has come to light in Karnataka's Kolar district, where a police constable reportedly broke the rear windshield of a car following an argument with a motorist over a seatbelt violation.

body.html:
An alleged incident of police high-handedness has come to light in Karnataka's Kolar district, where a police constable reportedly broke the rear windshield of a car following an argument with a motorist over a seatbelt violation.

The incident took place in front of Nangali Police Station in Mulbagal taluk. The motorist, identified as Devaraj, was travelling from Bangarupalya in Andhra Pradesh to Bengaluru with his wife and child when he was stopped during a vehicle inspection.

According to sources, police personnel alleged that Devaraj was not wearing a seatbelt and asked him to pay the fine immediately. Devaraj reportedly requested that a notice and receipt be issued instead, stating that he did not have money at the time and would pay the penalty in court.

Sources said the police instructed him to move his vehicle to the side of the road. As Devaraj attempted to do so, one of the car's wheels allegedly brushed against the foot of Constable Srinivas.

Enraged by the incident, the constable allegedly struck the vehicle with his lathi, shattering the rear windshield.

Following the incident, Devaraj parked his car across the service road of National Highway 75 in protest, causing temporary traffic disruption near Nangali Police Station.

Devaraj and his family have accused the police of excessive use of authority, arguing that motorists are generally given time to pay traffic fines after a case is registered and questioning the insistence on immediate payment.

The incident has sparked criticism of the alleged police action, and a case is expected to be registered.

Further details are awaited.

#Karnataka #Kolar #Police #Seatbelt #TrafficCheck #ViralVideo

articles.title: Gym Trainer Shot Dead During Morning Workout in Haryana, CCTV Captures 10-Round Firing
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic gripped Haryana's Hansi on Thursday after a gym operator and trainer was shot dead by two bike-borne assailants during an early morning exercise session near Fountain Chowk, police said.

body.html:
Panic gripped Haryana's Hansi on Thursday after a gym operator and trainer was shot dead by two bike-borne assailants during an early morning exercise session near Fountain Chowk, police said.

The victim, identified as Kapil, a resident of Dalamwala village, was conducting a workout session for several youths, including women, on the ramp outside a row of shops at around 5:25 am when the attack took place.

According to preliminary information, two helmeted assailants arrived on a motorcycle and opened fire before fleeing the spot. Eyewitnesses said around 10 rounds were fired within a few seconds.

Police said Kapil sustained multiple bullet injuries to his back and head and died on the spot.

During the firing, a young woman identified as Shikha, who was warming up at the location, suffered injuries after being hit by pellet fragments. She was shifted to a private hospital in Hisar, where she is undergoing treatment.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras installed in the area. Police have retrieved the footage and are examining it to identify the attackers and reconstruct the sequence of events.

Soon after receiving information, police teams reached the spot, cordoned off the area and launched an investigation. Personnel from the CIA unit and forensic teams have also joined the probe.

Preliminary investigation suggests that Kapil had recently entered into an inter-caste love marriage and had allegedly been receiving threats from the woman's family members. Police are investigating all possible angles, including whether the murder was linked to the marriage, but said no conclusions have been drawn so far.

Senior police official Vinod Kumar said efforts are underway to identify and arrest the accused using CCTV footage and other available evidence.

Further investigation is in progress.

#Hansi #Haryana #GymTrainer #CCTV #Murder #BreakingNews
